title: Barnes & Noble names Incorruptible to The Best Books of 2026 — Business
summary: Barnes & Noble's year-end Best Books of 2026 names Incorruptible in its Business category, and puts the cover on the category's own artwork — one of nine, alongside Open to Work, The Nerd Reich, The Forever Paycheck and 1873. It lands at the end of a year of best-of lists: Thinkers50's Best New Management Books, the Financial Times twice over for business summer reading, Adam Grant's top spring and summer read, the Masters of Scale summer list, Next Big Idea Club, Porchlight and HR Magazine. The individual verdicts have run further than any list: Steve Blank calls it the best startup or corporate book of the decade, Dan Heath the best and most important business book of the year, Don MacPherson the best he has read in twenty years, and Rebecca Henderson of Harvard her favourite business book of the last five.
blockquote: Best start up / corporate book of the decade. Should be on everybody's reading list.
